intro: A registered nurse resume that leads with registration and specialty, then shows clinical scope, leadership and improvements to patient care.
tips: Put your registration and specialty in the headline and summary.
Give the unit, its size and its patients for each role.
Show quality improvements and teaching as well as clinical care.

basics.name: Hannah Walsh
basics.label: Registered Nurse, Intensive Care
basics.summary: Registered nurse (NMBI) with nine years in emergency and intensive care. Charge nurse on a 20-bed ICU, preceptor for new graduates, and part of the team that brought in sepsis screening across the hospital.

work.name: St. Brigid's University Hospital
highlights: Lead a shift team of 12 nurses caring for ventilated and post-surgical patients.
Co-led the hospital's sepsis screening programme; time to antibiotics fell from 3 hours to under 1.
Preceptor to 15 new graduate nurses, all retained past their first year.

work.name: Mater Hospital
highlights: Triaged and treated patients across resuscitation, majors and minors.
Trained colleagues in the new electronic triage system.
